title: Resolution urging Albany to let disabled veterans use HOV lane
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Department of Transportation to let veterans with a 100 percent service-connected disability rating use the Staten Island Expressway's high occupancy vehicle lane regardless of how many people are in the car. It cites difficulties such veterans may face traveling to medical appointments and other essential destinations. The resolution notes that over 10,000 veterans live on Staten Island, including about 3,000 with a disability.
